results.title: Monid: OpenRouter for agent tools | Product Hunt
results.content:
Title: Monid: OpenRouter for agent tools | Product Hunt
## OpenRouter for agent tools. We connect your AI agent to 1,800+ APIs without any subscriptions. Your agent can now discover, run, and pay for tools at runtime. ## MonidLaunches. Launched on September 2nd, 2026. Monid 2.0OpenRouter for agent tools. Launched on May 8th, 2026. MonidOne wallet, every paid tool your agent needs. Launched on April 23rd, 2026. #### What's great. one key for 1,800 APIs instead of separately signing up, testing, and billing for each provider is a genuinely big time save if you're building anything agent-based. the fact that the agent itself can search the catalog and pick a tool by price/reliability/performance at runtime, instead of you hardcoding which API to call, fits how agent workflows actually behave in practice - the right tool for a task isn't always known ahead of time. #### What needs improvement. not clear from the launch page whether there's a spend cap or budget ceiling per agent/key - with 1,800 paid APIs behind one key, a bad retry loop or stuck agent could rack up a real bill before a human notices. a hard per-key spend limit would make this much safer to hand to something fully autonomous. #### vs Alternatives. Merge is built for syncing your own app's data models across customer SaaS tools (CRM, HRIS, etc) - it's an integrations layer for a product you're building. Monid is a different shape of problem: giving an autonomous agent runtime access to a huge catalog of external tools and data sources on demand, not wiring fixed integrations into your own backend ahead of time.
